body:
PAUSED by the maintainer — the audience assumption behind this epic was corrected.

Maintainer, 2026-08-24 chat, quoted verbatim: 「协作者不会多，我在云端手工加入都可以，主要是 业务用户怎么方便的注册进来，你先和我讨论方案。」

This epic builds the **cloud-organization** join link — membership in the control plane, i.e. the COLLABORATOR layer (env list, development, billing visibility). The maintainer states that layer is low-volume and manual invitation is acceptable, so the epic's justification is withdrawn for now. The real need is the **business-user** layer: convenient self-registration into a tenant ENVIRONMENT (e.g. `steedos.objectos.ai`), which is a different runtime, different tables, different auth surface — the code here does not transfer.

Dispatch stopped mid-run; branch `claude/issue-11587-org-join-link-v1` exists with partial work and is left in place. No PR was opened.

Restart-when: the business-user onboarding design (under discussion with the maintainer 2026-08-24) concludes and the maintainer rules that a cloud-org join link is still wanted.

Live readings that informed the correction (measured on `steedos.objectos.ai` `/api/v1/auth/config`, 2026-08-24): `emailPassword.disableSignUp=false`, `requireEmailVerification=false`, `socialProviders=[objectstack-cloud]`, `features.ssoEnforced=false`, `tenancyPosture=single`. Env-side self-registration is open and unverified today, and `reconcileMembership` (policy default `auto`) auto-binds each new user into the env's single org — that is the surface the business-user design must address.

Closing **not planned** — the hold's `Restart-when:` condition has fired, and the answer is "not wanted now".

That condition was: *the business-user onboarding design concludes and the maintainer rules whether a cloud-org join link is still wanted.* The design concluded today as objectstack-ai/objectstack#11723 (audience posture, ruled and dispatched). The maintainer's ruling on the collaborator layer, quoted verbatim from the 2026-08-24 chat, is:

> 「协作者不会多，我在云端手工加入都可以，主要是 业务用户怎么方便的注册进来，你先和我讨论方案。」

Manual invitation covers the collaborator (cloud-organization) layer at current volume, so this epic has no pull. Per the maintainer's standing guidance (2026-08-16, verbatim: 「我建议有些暂时不准备开发的应该直接关闭。」), work with no firable restart condition is closed rather than held — the card IS the record, and reopening is free.

Preserved for whoever revives this: the V1 token shape reasoned out here (one active link per org, role pinned to `member`, default 7-day expiry, revoke/rotate, optional max-uses, membership written through the governed `addMember` path, verified-email posture per better-auth GHSA-fmh4-wcc4-5jm3) is directly reusable if a `link` value is ever added to the audience-posture vocabulary in #11723. Branch `claude/issue-11587-org-join-link-v1` holds partial work; no PR was opened.
